name: Issue 3195: Speed Rune buffs allies inside its runic path with a native movement speed aura
contract: Speed Rune 801103 (APPLY_AURA/PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL, amplitude 10ms, duration 100ms) periodically triggers
572134, whose two TRIGGER_SPELL effects fire 572136 at TARGET_DEST_CASTER_FRONT (3 yd spread) and 572135 on
the caster (TARGET_UNIT_CASTER, a self-only flat modifier). 572136 is a native PERSISTENT_AREA_AURA
(radius 4 yd, duration 10000ms, matching the tooltip's 10 sec) whose own PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL (amplitude
250ms) casts 802725 on TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY inside it: 802725 applies SPELL_AURA_MOD_INCREASE_SPEED with
EffectBasePoints[0]=69 (displayed 70%, matching the tooltip's 70% ally speed bonus). 572135 only reaches the
caster, not allies. All effect/aura types (TRIGGER_SPELL, PERSISTENT_AREA_AURA, PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL,
MOD_INCREASE_SPEED) are stock native AzerothCore dispatch; no CoA code runs at 801103, 572134, 572136 or

steps.label: SETUP: ally starts without the movement speed aura
CONTRACT: ally inside the runic path gains the native movement speed aura
CONTRACT: ally run speed rises toward the tooltip's 70% bonus
